title: Harness Business Value Realization (BVR)
subtitle: Executive QBR view of the value Harness delivers across CI, CD and STO: adoption, velocity, delivery performance, security posture and estimated ROI.

widget.text:
## Harness Business Value Realization
Value delivered across **CI, CD and STO** for the selected period. ROI figures are **estimates**: 2h manual effort saved per deployment, 0.25h per build, 0.5h per security scan, at $100/engineering hour. Environment Type filter applies to CD widgets only.

widget.title: Total Pipeline Executions
widget.subtitle: All pipeline runs across every Harness module

widget.title: Active Projects
widget.subtitle: Projects with at least one pipeline run

widget.title: Active Pipelines
widget.subtitle: Distinct pipelines executed in the period

widget.title: Executions by Module
widget.subtitle: Pipeline runs containing a stage of each module (Platform = approvals / chained pipelines)

widget.title: Monthly Executions by Module
widget.subtitle: Adoption trend: pipeline runs per month, stacked by module

widget.title: Builds
widget.subtitle: CI pipeline executions in the period

widget.title: Build Success Rate
widget.subtitle: Successful builds ÷ all builds (incl. ignore-failed)

widget.title: Median Build Time
widget.subtitle: Median end-to-end CI build duration (lower is better)

widget.title: Builds per Day by Outcome

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe
| filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { date_trunc("day", pe.startts) as day,
    (case when pe.status = 'SUCCESS' or pe.status = 'IGNOREFAILED' then 'Success' when pe.status = 'FAILED' then 'Failed' else 'Aborted/Expired' end) as outcome,
    count() as builds }
| group_by day, outcome
| order_by day asc

widget.subtitle: Daily build throughput stacked by result

widget.title: Deployments
widget.subtitle: Deployment stages executed (all environments)

widget.title: Services Deployed
widget.subtitle: Distinct services shipped through Harness CD pipelines

widget.title: Deployment Frequency / Week
widget.subtitle: DORA: average deployments per week in the period

widget.title: Median Deployment Duration
widget.subtitle: DORA lead-time proxy: median deployment stage duration

widget.title: Change Failure Rate
widget.subtitle: DORA: failed/aborted/expired deployments ÷ all deployments (all environments)

widget.title: Weekly Deployments by Environment Type

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.end_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.end_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { date_trunc("week", d.end_ts) as week,
    (case when d.env_type = 'Production' then 'Production' when d.env_type = 'PreProduction' then 'Pre-Production' else 'Other / Custom' end) as environment,
    count() as deployments }
| group_by week, environment
| order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: Deployment cadence per week, stacked by environment type

widget.title: Failed Deployments Caught Pre-Prod

widget.title: Monthly Value Delivered (Estimated)

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:pipeline_execution" pe
| left join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" ci on ci.planexecutionid = pe.plan_execution_id
| left join view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d on d.plan_execution_id = pe.plan_execution_id
| left join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.plan_execution_id = pe.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { date_trunc("month", pe.start_ts) as month,
    cast(round(distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) * 2.0 + distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) * 0.25 + distinct_count(s.id) * 0.5, 0) as double) as hours_saved,
    cast(round((distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) * 2.0 + distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) * 0.25 + distinct_count(s.id) * 0.5) * 100, 0) as double) as savings_usd }
| group_by month
| order_by month asc

widget.subtitle: Hours saved (left axis) and $ value at $100/hr (right axis) per month

widget.title: Annualized Savings ($)

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:pipeline_execution" pe
| left join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" ci on ci.planexecutionid = pe.plan_execution_id
| left join view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d on d.plan_execution_id = pe.plan_execution_id
| left join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.plan_execution_id = pe.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { cast(round((distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) * 2.0 + distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) * 0.25 + distinct_count(s.id) * 0.5) * 100 * 365.0
    / date_diff(cast(${start_time} as timestamp), cast(${end_time} as timestamp), "day"), 0) as double) as annualized_savings_usd }

widget.subtitle: Estimated savings for the period projected to a 12-month run-rate

widget.title: Critical / High Vulns Caught Pre-Release

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:detection" det
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = det.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = det.account_identifier
| filter det.detected >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and det.detected <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and (det.severity_code = 'Critical' or det.severity_code = 'High')
| aggregate { count() as critical_high_caught }

widget.subtitle: Critical + High detections found by pipeline scans before release

widget.title: Project Scorecard — CI, CD & STO

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:pipeline_execution" pe
| left join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" ci on ci.planexecutionid = pe.plan_execution_id
| left join view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d on d.plan_execution_id = pe.plan_execution_id
| left join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.plan_execution_id = pe.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    pe.org_identifier as organization,
    pe.project_identifier as project,
    distinct_count(pe.plan_execution_id) as executions,
    distinct_count(pe.pipeline_identifier) as pipelines,
    distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) as builds,
    round(distinct_count(case when pe.status = 'SUCCESS' or pe.status = 'IGNOREFAILED' then pe.plan_execution_id end) * 100.0
      / distinct_count(pe.plan_execution_id), 1) as pipeline_success_pct,
    round(distinct_count(case when ci.status = 'SUCCESS' or ci.status = 'IGNOREFAILED' then ci.planexecutionid end) * 100.0
      / (case when distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) = 0 then null else distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) end), 1) as build_success_pct,
    distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) as deployments,
    round(distinct_count(case when d.stage_status = 'SUCCESS' then d.stage_execution_id end) * 100.0
      / (case when distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) = 0 then null else distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) end), 1) as deploy_success_pct,
    distinct_count(s.id) as security_scans,
    cast(round((distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) * 2.0 + distinct_count(ci.planexecutionid) * 0.25 + distinct_count(s.id) * 0.5) * 100, 0) as double) as est_savings_usd
  }
| group_by pe.org_identifier, pe.project_identifier
| order_by executions desc
| limit 50

widget.subtitle: Per-project adoption and outcomes across modules; est. savings uses the ROI assumptions above

widget.title: Top Services by Deployments

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.end_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.end_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate} and d.service_name is not null and d.service_name is not empty
| aggregate {
    d.service_name as service,
    d.project_identifier as project,
    count() as deployments,
    distinct_count(d.env_identifier) as environments,
    round(count(case when d.stage_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 end) * 100.0 / count(), 1) as success_pct,
    round(median(d.stage_duration) / 1000.0, 0) as median_duration_s
  }
| group_by d.service_name, d.project_identifier
| order_by deployments desc
| limit 15

widget.subtitle: Most frequently deployed services with success rate and median duration

widget.title: Top Vulnerable Projects

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:all_baseline_issue_summary" a
| inner join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = a.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter a.status = 'Active' and a.last_modified >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_modified <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    h_l.project_identifier as project,
    distinct_count(case when a.severity_code = 'Critical' then a.issue_id end) as critical,
    distinct_count(case when a.severity_code = 'High' then a.issue_id end) as high,
    distinct_count(case when a.severity_code = 'Medium' then a.issue_id end) as medium,
    distinct_count(a.issue_id) as total_active
  }
| group_by h_l.project_identifier
| order_by critical desc, high desc
| limit 15

widget.subtitle: Projects with the most open Critical/High issues — remediation focus areas
